text.tspan: By analysing the clues, identify India's land-based neighbours.
India is connected to its neighbours through both land and sea.
A country that shares a land border with another country.
A country that is connected to another country through
the sea without sharing a land border.
Tap the flag, then based on the clues, tap the correct neighbour of India in the map.

Not Really! Check more clues to get it right.
● This country was born in 1971 as the outcome of a war between India and its another neighbour.
● This country's land border with India is even longer than India's border with China, running along
West Bengal, Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura and Mizoram.
● This nations houses major portion of world's largest mangrove forest, home to the Bengal tiger.
● Bangla, a language shared with India's West Bengal, is the common tongue here.
● Known to its own people as 'Drukyul', or Land of the Thunder Dragon, this kingdom's border
with India touches Sikkim, West Bengal, Assam and Arunachal Pradesh.
● The dragon on this country's flag and emblem is said to symbolise the thunderous voice of
the Buddha's teachings, introduced here in the 8th century CE.
● Rivers originating here flow into India and power joint hydroelectric projects, including one
dedicated by both countries' prime ministers in 2008.
